caption:
why does skin feel so tight after a flight?

In a small study of 8 women on long-haul flights, cabin humidity dropped below 10% within two hours and stayed low. Their cheek hydration fell by up to 37%.

The CDC describes cabin air as usually 10 to 20% humidity.

So pack a small moisturizer in your carry-on, 100 ml or less.

Save this before your long-haul flight.

Sources: Guéhenneux et al., Skin Res Technol 2012 (8 women). CDC Yellow Book, Air Travel (2025).
